profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Everything your CVs and letters say about you comes from here, and nothing else.

start.title: Start your profile
start.body: Upload your CV and AI fills your profile for you, or add entries by hand. Nothing is used for generation until you verify it.

profile.checksOut: Every entry checks out. Your CVs can use all of it.
profile.noMatchBody: Try another word, or clear the filter.

project.title: Projects
project.empty: Things you built or led, at work or on your own.

skill.title: Skills
skill.empty: Groups of skills, e.g. “Cloud” or “Customer service”.

language.title: Languages
language.empty: Languages you speak and your level.

card.lineNeedsFact: A CV line needs a fact

identity.title: Identity & contact
identity.description: Copied as-is into every CV and letter. AI never changes these.
identity.headline: Headline
identity.headlineHint: The line under your name. A job can adjust it; it never invents seniority.
identity.aboutHint: A short paragraph at the top of your CV. AI can tailor it per job using only your verified facts.
identity.photoHint: Try a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo under 2 MB.

searchGoals.title: What you’re looking for
searchGoals.description: Every job is checked against these before your skills: contract, place, work mode, and where you can legally work.
searchGoals.empty: No goals yet. Add one, like “PFE internship in Paris, 6 months” or “CDI in France”, and each fit check will tell you when a job doesn’t fit it.
searchGoals.emptyLocation: No goals yet, so jobs are only checked against your location ({location}). Add one, like “PFE internship in Paris, 6 months” or “CDI in France”, and each fit check will tell you when a job doesn’t fit it.

dialog.rolesHint: Up to 3. Job discovery searches for these, in this goal's places.
dialog.description: Leave a section empty if anything goes.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.placesPlaceholder: Paris, Lyon, or a country like France
dialog.placesHint: Cities or countries, separated by commas. “Paris” also covers La Défense and the rest of Île-de-France.
dialog.visa: You can work without a visa in
dialog.visaHint: Jobs in other countries get flagged unless they offer sponsorship.
dialog.timingHint: When you can start, and how long, in months, for internships, alternance and fixed-term jobs (e.g. 5 to 6 for a PFE).

toast.created: {count, plural, one {# new entry} other {# new entries}}
toast.reverify: {count, plural, one {# verified entry needs a quick re-check for the new facts.} other {# verified entries need a quick re-check for the new facts.}}
toast.review: Saved and verified. Edit anything any time.

profileImport.title: Start from your CV
profileImport.description: Give me your CV, your LinkedIn export or a few notes. I’ll sort it into jobs, studies, projects and skills, and split achievements into facts. I never add anything you didn’t write, and nothing is used until you verify it.
profileImport.drop: Drop your CV here or click to choose
profileImport.formats: PDF, LinkedIn export (.zip) or text, up to 8 MB
profileImport.pastePlaceholder: Paste your CV, your LinkedIn “About” and “Experience”, or just write about your jobs…
profileImport.timing: Usually 15–40 seconds. I’ll show you everything before saving.
profileImport.summary: {created} new · {merged} to update · {skipped} skipped. Entries you already have are updated with only what’s new; nothing you wrote is overwritten.
profileImport.apply: Looks right, save to my profile
profileImport.known: {count, plural, one {# fact already there} other {# facts already there}}
profileImport.recheck: it will need a quick re-check
profileImport.dropped: {count, plural, one {# item left out: its numbers weren’t in your CV.} other {# items left out: their numbers weren’t in your CV.}}
profileImport.applyHint: Saving confirms these entries are accurate. You can still edit any of them later.

reviewQueue.allGood: Every entry is verified and every bullet is backed by a fact.
reviewQueue.noFactsYet: This entry has no facts yet. Add the one that proves this bullet.
reviewQueue.newFactHint: Write only what you can prove. Keep the exact numbers; this becomes part of your verified profile.
reviewQueue.addAsFact: It’s true but missing — add it as a fact
reviewQueue.backedBy: {count, plural, one {Backed by # fact} other {Backed by # facts}}
reviewQueue.heading: It’s a heading, not a claim
reviewQueue.isTrue: Is everything here true and current?
reviewQueue.isTrueHint: Verified entries are the only ones Naruvi uses to write CVs.
reviewQueue.noFactsOpen: Jobs and projects are stronger with at least one concrete achievement. Edit the entry to add one, or verify it as is.
reviewQueue.ungrounded: {count, plural, one {# bullet in this entry still needs a fact; it appears separately in this queue.} other {# bullets in this entry still need a fact; they appear separately in this queue.}}
